title: Red Baron Personal Pan Pizza (box directions)
description: Package directions for a frozen Red Baron Personal Pan Pizza, from the box.

ingredients.item: frozen Red Baron Personal Pan Pizza

steps: Conventional oven (recommended): Preheat oven to 375°F. Place oven rack in center position.
Remove pizza from clear plastic wrap. Discard plastic and silver cooking tray. Caution: do not use tray in oven.
When oven is preheated, place frozen pizza on a cookie sheet and then place on the center rack. Bake for 22-24 minutes or until cheese is melted and lightly browned.
source: Red Baron box (photo Joe sent Oven Air Fry Chef, Oct 11, 2026)
notes:
Microwave oven (1100 watts), from the box: only cook 1 pizza at a time. Remove pizza from carton. Remove overwrap from silver tray and pizza. Place frozen pizza directly on the silver cooking surface, and then place on a microwave-safe plate. Cook on high (100% power) for 2 minutes 45 seconds to 3 minutes 45 seconds. Product is ready when cheese is completely melted. Carefully remove from microwave and let cool for 1 minute before serving.
Samsung Air Fry: NOT verified. On Oct 11, 2026, Bake 375°F preheat, then Air Fry 375°F for 22 min directly on the center rack burned the top (crust only a little overdone). Joe said not to send corrected directions. See methods/lesson-red-baron-personal-pan-pizza-2026-10-11.md. The meal pack says to use regular Bake mode for frozen pizza.
